mapper.select: SELECT activity_day, SUM(posts) AS posts, SUM(comments) AS comments, SUM(feedbacks) AS feedbacks FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at + INTERVAL 9 HOUR) AS activity_day, COUNT(*) AS posts, 0 AS comments, 0 AS feedbacks FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY activity_day UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at + INTERVAL 9 HOUR), 0, COUNT(*), 0 FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at + INTERVAL 9 HOUR), 0, 0, COUNT(*) FROM feedbacks WHERE created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1 ) activity GROUP BY activity_day ORDER BY activity_day

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status = 'DONE'), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'NOT_FOOD'), 0) AS not_food, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'FAILED'), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED'), 0) AS limit_exceeded, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency_ms, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM food_analyses WHERE created_at >= #{from}

SELECT MIN(latency_ms) FROM ( SELECT latency_ms, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS cumulative FROM food_analyses WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE cumulative >= 0.95

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_posts, COUNT(location.post_id) AS with_location FROM posts post LEFT JOIN post_locations location ON location.post_id = post.id WHERE post.status = 'ACTIVE' AND post.created_at >= #{from}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(progress = 'RECEIVED'), 0) AS received, COALESCE(SUM(progress = 'IN_PROGRESS'), 0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(SUM(progress = 'DONE'), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(progress = 'ON_HOLD'), 0) AS on_hold FROM feedbacks WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
